mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, scope VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', idem_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, result TEXT, error VARCHAR(500), expire_at DATETIME NOT NULL, finished_at DATETIME, host VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_idem_scope_key (scope, idem_key), KEY idx_idem_expire (expire_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, scope, idem_key, status, expire_at, host, gmt_create) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.scope}, #{row.idemKey}, #{row.status}, #{row.expireAt}, #{row.host}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, idem_key AS idemKey, status, result, error, expire_at AS expireAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, host, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM ${table} WHERE scope = #{scope} AND idem_key = #{idemKey}
SELECT id FROM ${table} WHERE expire_at < #{now} LIMIT #{batchSize}
SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE UPPER(TABLE_NAME) = UPPER(#{table})
